versions.changelog:
Initial release: Cross-platform game library query tool with Chinese name support.

- Unified search, statistics, and recommendation for Steam and Epic Games libraries
- Automatic display and search by Chinese game names (dual-source: Steam API & 小黑盒)
- Command-line interface with options for library list, search, statistics, recommendations, and updates
- Includes scripts to update and supplement Chinese name cache
- Supports search by both Chinese and English names, plus detection of duplicates
- Requires Steam CLI (with API key) and Legendary for Epic
